description: Land Acquisition - Bambaragahapalassa, Weerambugedara D/S Division, Kurunegala District Lots (101)
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land lots to be acquired by the state for a public purpose. It contains descriptions of land parcels, their uses, claimants, and extents, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
